categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Sanfu New Materials Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in surface engineering specialized chemicals and equipment. Its main business segments include electronic chemicals, general electroplating chemicals, and surface engineering specialized equipment. The company serves industries such as PCB manufacturing, passive components, new energy (lithium batteries, photovoltaics), semiconductor, communication electronics, automotive parts, and hardware sanitary ware.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced surface engineering technologies including pulse electroplating, chemical nickel-gold plating, horizontal copper deposition, and composite copper foil electroplating. It develops environmentally friendly, non-toxic chemical formulations such as cyanide-free, chromium-free, lead-free, cadmium-free, phosphorus-free, and low COD chemicals. Production methods mainly involve physical mixing and stirring of chemical formulations, with specialized equipment designed for precise electroplating processes, including vertical conveyor plating and wet composite copper foil plating.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are PCB manufacturers, electronic communication companies, automotive parts producers, new energy battery manufacturers, and hardware sanitary ware producers. Major end markets include AI servers, 3C electronics, smart automotive electronics, semiconductor packaging, and new energy storage. The company has established stable relationships with nearly 1,000 customers, including leading domestic and international PCB and electronics firms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing and R&D facilities in Guangzhou, Jiangxi, Nanjing, Suzhou, Ningbo, Shenzhen, Xiamen, Zhongshan, Huizhou, and Chongqing. It has also expanded overseas with investments in Thailand and exports technology to Belarus. Sales cover domestic markets extensively and include some international sales, particularly in Eastern Europe and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sanfu New Materials operates upstream and midstream in the surface engineering supply chain, providing specialized chemicals and equipment to downstream PCB manufacturers, electronics producers, and new energy battery makers. It integrates chemical product development with equipment manufacturing to offer comprehensive surface engineering solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in green, efficient, and high-performance surface engineering technologies. Strategic R&D priorities include pulse electroplating, composite copper foil manufacturing, environmentally friendly chemical formulations, and intelligent equipment integration. It pursues a '3+2' business development strategy focusing on electronic chemicals, general electroplating chemicals, equipment, new energy, and specialty chemicals. R&D '3+1' strategy focuses on talent, equipment, testing, and customer certification. The company also invests heavily in digital platforms for R&D, production, marketing, and finance.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of specialized chemical products and customized surface engineering equipment. The company uses a direct sales model supplemented by limited distribution. It also earns income from technical services, installation, and after-sales support. Investment income and disposal of subsidiaries contribute to non-operating income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sanfu New Materials is a leading domestic player in surface engineering chemicals and equipment, competing against international giants like Atotech, Rohm&Haas, and MacDermid Alpha Electronics Solutions. It holds a strong position in the domestic market with growing market share in high-end PCB and new energy sectors, leveraging cost advantages, localized service, and innovation to accelerate import substitution and challenge foreign dominance.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 621 million, a 24.9% increase year-over-year. Despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 12.58 million, the loss narrowed compared to previous years. R&D investment increased by 44.5% to RMB 73 million, accounting for 11.76% of revenue. Total assets reached RMB 1.27 billion, with net assets attributable to shareholders at RMB 508 million, showing steady growth and ongoing expansion through acquisitions and organic development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sanfu New Materials differentiates itself through its integrated 'chemical + equipment' solution model, strong R&D capabilities, and focus on environmentally friendly, high-performance surface engineering products. It offers advanced technologies such as pulse electroplating and composite copper foil plating that reduce costs and improve efficiency for customers. The company emphasizes localized service, rapid innovation cycles, and compliance with stringent environmental standards, positioning itself as a trusted partner for domestic PCB, new energy, and electronics manufacturers aiming for high-quality, sustainable production.
